---
title: The engine
description: "One Node process with switchable parts: it relays prices, indexes the chain, keeps rounds moving, runs the agents and sends alerts."
---

| Part | Does |
|---|---|
| `oracle` | streams General Protocols' messages, checks each signature, stores it |
| `price` | the live line: an exchange ticker re-based to the oracle; never settles |
| `indexer` | follows every contract address and rebuilds the read model |
| `keeper` | every 5 seconds: lock, settle, pay what's due; open the next rounds |
| `agents` | reads rounds for each agent (60 model calls an hour, all agents), signs vault bets |
| `push` | alerts for payouts and proposals |
| `paths` | keeps each decided round's price path for its replay |
| `faucet` | chipnet test coins |

`ENGINE_COMPONENTS` picks which parts run. Each keeper step is claimed in the database first, so two engines never do the same work; a broadcast answered "already" means someone else sent it.

| Keeper setting | |
|---|---|
| `KEEPER_LANES` | lanes kept open nonstop (chipnet: the four markets) |
| `KEEPER_DEMAND` | also open lanes someone is watching (mainnet) |
| `KEEPER_WIF` | pays for opening rounds; without it the keeper still locks, settles and pays |
